purpose: Exploratory restricted-role operator detail comparison; not a production capacity or SLO qualification.
order: Two exclusive-fence runs followed by two shared-fence runs, each with fresh disposable services.
sourceState: Working trees on cbb1f036a586541865d4a31d806764eab24a281d. Source and release binary hashes identify each measured variant; these are not clean-commit measurements.
limitations: Two runs and eight read commands per run cannot establish stable tail estimates or isolate host drift.
Generated accounts have no credentials or assignments; 64 added roles are unassigned and bound only to the first application.
No stage timings, SQL protocol round trips, query plans, peak resource samples, missing/denied CLI load, sustained saturation, or multi-replica deployment measurements.
Source reports and per-request traces remain untracked local evidence. This file retains bounded summaries and trace digests; it omits operation audit identifiers.

metadata.topology: One host release Rust process, Node TLS proxy and load generator; Docker Percona primary plus separate Redis cache/limiter containers on loopback. Chromium provisions real login/SSO credentials.
unmeasured: pool acquisition and authorization stage timings
SQL statement counts and WAL observations
multi-hour endurance and production arrival distributions

operatorLimits.note: Configured maxima, not observed peaks. CLI and HTTP use deployment runtime grants; container and replica qualification remain separate.
